- **Install:** `dsh plugin --profile web add github:sakthiveltofficial/dsh-gmail-plugins`, then"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" add one row to your profile patch (or agent preset) — see Install.
- **Tools:** `gmail_send_email`,"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" `gmail_fetch_emails`, `gmail_fetch_message_by_message_id`, `gmail_fetch_message_by_thread_id`, `gma"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"il_list_threads`, `gmail_reply_to_thread`, `gmail_create_email_draft`, `gmail_send_draft`, `gmail_fo"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"rward_message`, label/filter/trash/settings/contacts tools — the full list is in the tool table.
- *"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"*Auth:** OAuth2 (`gmail.modify`, `gmail.settings.basic`, `gmail.compose`, `gmail.send`, `contacts.re"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"adonly` scopes). Credentials are **never stored in config** — env-var references resolved per operat"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ion via `ctx.credentials`. `gmail_authorize` runs the interactive Google sign-in and **captures + st"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"ores the refresh token automatically**; only `GMAIL_CLIENT_ID` / `GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET` need to be se"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"t.
- **Triggers:** `gmail/message-received` (new mail) and `gmail/message-sent` (sent mail) — poll-b"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ased, seeded on first activation so the mailbox is never replayed.
- **Runtime requirements:** DeepS"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"eek Harness, Node.js ≥ 20 (global `fetch`), and a Google Cloud OAuth client with the Gmail (and Peop"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"le) API enabled.
- **Safety:** permanent deletes (`gmail_delete_message`, `gmail_batch_delete_messag"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"es`, `gmail_delete_thread`, `gmail_delete_label`) are clearly labeled and require explicit user conf"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"irmation; the agent is prompted to prefer trash over permanent deletion unless the user asked for ir"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"reversible removal.
- **License:** MIT."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ✨ What it does"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Read & search** — fetch emails with Gmail query syntax, fetch a message by ID or a full thread, "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"list threads, list/get drafts, download attachments, get profile/history.
- **Compose & send** — sen"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"d email (with attachments from local paths, URLs, or inline base64), create/update/send drafts, forw"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ard messages, reply inside a thread (correct `In-Reply-To`/`References` threading).
- **Organize** —"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" add/remove labels (single message, batch of 1,000, or whole thread), create/patch/update/delete lab"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"els, create/list/get/delete filters.
- **Administer** — IMAP/POP settings, auto-forwarding, vacation"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" responder, display language, send-as aliases, S/MIME configs, CSE identities/key pairs, stop watch "},{"id":"p8s8","text":"notifications.
- **Contacts** — get contacts (connections), get a person or Other Contacts, search p"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"eople via the People API.
- **One-click auth** — `gmail_authorize` opens the Google consent page in "},{"id":"p8s10","text":"your browser and captures + stores the refresh token automatically; no manual token generation.
- **"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"Triggers** — poll for new received/sent mail and emit typed Cordis events for downstream listeners.

Config carries only **env-var references**, never "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"literal tokens; values are resolved per operation through DSH's credential service (process env → pr"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ovider store → `.env`)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Env var | Used for |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## 🔒 Security"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Secrets are never stored in config** — only env-var references (`GMAIL_CLIENT_ID` / `GMAIL_CLIEN"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"T_SECRET` / `GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN`), resolved per operation through `ctx.credentials` (process env → "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"provider store → `.env`). Literal config values are supported for quick setups but are not recommend"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"ed for production.
- **Access tokens are cached in memory only**, never persisted, and are refreshed"},{"id":"p30s5","text":" from the refresh token on demand.
- **Destructive tools are clearly labeled** in their descriptions"},{"id":"p30s6","text":" (`permanent`, `no recovery possible`) and the agent is instructed to confirm with the user before p"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"ermanent deletes and to prefer trash for reversible workflows.
- **Forward/reply recipients are expl"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"icit** — forwarding preserves content, so the agent is instructed to verify recipients before forwar"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"ding to avoid unintended exposure.
- Minimum privilege: grant only the scopes your workflows need (d"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"rop `gmail.settings.basic` or `contacts.readonly` if unused — an over-scoped client can trigger the "},{"id":"p30s11","text":""App is blocked" verification requirement)."}],"truncated":true}
